description: This is a PHP source file for a web-based network diagnostic tools page. It includes PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for testing network connectivity, checking IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and performing traceroute operations. The file incorporates multiple forms, validation scripts, and dynamic interactions to facilitate troubleshooting tasks within a web UI.

methods.name: showTracerouteDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with traceroute results.

methods.name: checkTraceError
methods.description: Checks traceroute status and displays appropriate dialogs and styling.
